basic_info.description: Welcome to this pristine, chic, and luxurious two-story condo, featuring an elegant balcony off the living area and a peaceful landscaped patio in the rear. This three-bedroom, two-full-bathroom, 1,547-sq. ft. condo is located in Summit 800 and was built in 2015. Features: Viking appliances, a gas cooktop, stone counters, hardwood floors, high ceilings, a large primary en-suite bedroom, walk-in closet, large bathroom on the upper floor. Full bathroom on main fl. Owned solar. The small community is designed to foster a warm neighborhood atmosphere, nestled away from Brotherhood Way, just off 19th Avenue on the west side of San Francisco. Enjoy tree-lined streets with sidewalks and a crescent-shaped two-acre green space with a playground, a dog run, and a public plaza. The sculpture Peace by Benjamin Bufano stands prominently in front of this green space, adding to the area's charm. The location is ideal, with proximity to The Olympic Club, San Francisco Golf Course, Lake Merced, Fort Funston, and Thornton State Beach. You'll also be near the world-famous Golden Gate Park, offering endless opportunities to enjoy nature. The location is perfect whether you work in the city (Muni) or need a short commute to the Peninsula. Tandem two-car garage parking with access from the interior.
